Effective date: 1 September 2026. Owner: Group Policy Office, Kestrel Ridge Manufacturing.
1. Purpose. This standard sets the annual paid leave entitlement for full-time employees for all Kestrel Ridge Manufacturing entities.

The annual paid leave entitlement for full-time employees is 20 days, as stated in the Leave and Working Time Policy LE-25. The Brazil subsidiary follows a separate policy (LE-25-BR) with 22 days, but the general policy for all entities is LE-25.

    Records Retention Standard RE-25-BR (Brazil subsidiary addendum): retention period for financial transaction records
Effective date: 1 September 2026. Owner: Brazil subsidiary Policy Office, Kestrel Ridge Manufacturing.
1. Purpose. This addendum sets the retention period for financial transaction records for the Brazil subsidiary only; all other Kestrel Ridge Manufacturing entities follow RE-25.
2. Rule. The retention period for financial transaction records is 4 years.
3. Exceptions. Exceptions require written approval and must be logged within 8 business days.
4. Review. This standard is reviewed every 24 months.
  3. read SRC-0150: content returned

Effective date: 1 September 2026. Owner: Group Policy Office, Kestrel Ridge Manufacturing.
1. Purpose. This standard sets the retention period for financial transaction records for all Kestrel Ridge Manufacturing entities.
2. Rule. The retention period for financial transaction records is 6 years.
3. Exceptions. Exceptions require written approval and must be logged within 4 business days.
4. Review. This standard is reviewed every 24 months.

Final answer

The retention period for financial transaction records is 6 years, as stated in the Records Retention Standard RE-25.
